title: German Quinoa Bake
description: A hearty and comforting quinoa bake with a German twist, featuring savory sausage and onions.
instructions: Cook quinoa according to package instructions.
Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add sausage and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add sliced onion to skillet and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
In a large mixing bowl, combine cooked quinoa, sausage mixture, and shredded cheese.
Transfer mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until cheese is melted and bubbly.
